title: feat(nm2oricyclz): cyclic next/prev lex-largest det orientation of 1-in 2-out at t+1 on two-axis opposite z-probes: reverse HOLD, face HOLD
science: THE band's headline cell: opposite seed, z-probes, cyclic next/prev lex-largest det orientation, Orient=(-1,-1,+1,+1) giving reverse=HOLD and face=HOLD.
